# Millennium Chambers

> Gurugram-based legal practice (325H, Sector 38, Gurugram, Haryana 122001) advising Indian founders and growing companies on corporate, commercial and regulatory law, and acting as India-side counsel for foreign companies and law firms. Led by Advocate Varun Bhutani (Bar Council of Delhi, 2018). Website content is general information only, not legal advice or solicitation (Bar Council of India rules).

## Key pages

- [Varun Bhutani — Advocate, Gurugram](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/varun-bhutani-advocate-gurugram/): Varun Bhutani is an advocate in Gurugram (Gurgaon), enrolled with the Bar Council of Delhi since 2018, and Independent Partner of Millennium Chambers, advising on corporate, DPDP, labour and fundraising law.
- [Startup Lawyer in Gurgaon (Gurugram)](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/startup-lawyer-gurgaon-gurugram/): Startup lawyer in Gurgaon (Gurugram): Advocate Varun Bhutani, former Head of Legal at venture-backed companies, on founders' agreements, fundraising, contracts, DPDP, Labour Codes and trademarks.
- [Debt Recovery Lawyer in Gurgaon (Gurugram)](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/debt-recovery-lawyer-gurgaon/): Debt recovery lawyer in Gurgaon (Gurugram): Advocate Varun Bhutani on recovering loans and unpaid invoices through legal notices, Section 138 NI Act, SARFAESI, IBC, arbitration and commercial suits.
- [NBFC and Fintech Lawyer in Gurgaon (Gurugram)](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/nbfc-fintech-lawyer-gurgaon/): NBFC and fintech lawyer in Gurgaon (Gurugram): Advocate Varun Bhutani, formerly on Oxyzo's founding legal team, on loan documentation, RBI compliance, digital lending, debt fundraising and recovery.
- [Legal Retainer for Startups and Growing Companies](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/legal-retainer-outside-counsel-startups/): Monthly legal retainer for startups and growing companies without an in-house lawyer: contracts, notices, compliance, employment, fundraising support and trademarks, from a former Head of Legal.
- [India Legal Counsel for Foreign Companies and Law Firms](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/india-legal-counsel-foreign-companies/): India-side legal counsel for foreign companies and law firms: recovering dues from Indian parties, enforcing foreign judgments and awards, FEMA and DPDP compliance, licences and India entry.
- [India's Labour Codes: A Startup Guide](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/labour-codes-startups-india-guide/): What the four Labour Codes in force from 21 November 2025 mean for Indian startups: appointment letters, fixed-term gratuity, gig worker contributions, wages and a compliance checklist.
- [Startup Insights](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/startup-insights/): Weekly roundup of Indian startup funding rounds, SEBI, RBI, MCA and CERT-In regulatory changes, with a practical founder takeaway from a Gurugram startup lawyer.
- [Practice Areas](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/startup-corporate-law-practice-areas-gurugram/): Areas of practice at Millennium Chambers, Gurugram: startups and venture capital, contracts, debt recovery and insolvency, NBFC and fintech, DPDP Act, Labour Codes, consumer protection, trademarks and leasing.
- [Trademark Registration for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/trademark-registration-startups-india/): How Indian startups register a trademark: searching, choosing classes, filing Form TM-A, examination replies, opposition and renewal, with a practical founder checklist.
- [ESOPs for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/esop-startups-india-legal-guide/): ESOP law for Indian private companies: Section 62(1)(b) and Rule 12, vesting and exercise rules, DPIIT startup relaxations, taxation and a founder checklist.
- [DPDP Act Compliance for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/dpdp-act-compliance-startups-india/): DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025 for Indian startups: phased deadlines up to 13 May 2027, consent and notice duties, user rights, penalties up to Rs 250 crore and a checklist.
- [Founders' Agreement for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/founders-agreement-startups-india/): What Indian co-founders should agree in writing: equity split and vesting, roles, IP assignment, non-compete limits, exits and disputes, and making terms binding via the AoA.
- [Term Sheets for Startups in India](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/term-sheet-startups-india/): The term sheet clauses Indian founders must understand: valuation and ESOP pool, liquidation preference, anti-dilution, board and consent rights, vesting and the Companies Act/FEMA steps.
- [Disclaimer](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/disclaimer/): Bar Council of India disclaimer for the Millennium Chambers website: information only, no solicitation, no legal advice and no advocate-client relationship.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/privacy-policy/): How Millennium Chambers collects, uses, stores and protects information shared through this website, and how to contact us about your data.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/terms-of-use/): Terms governing use of the Millennium Chambers website, including permitted use, no professional engagement, liability and governing law.
- [MSME Payment Recovery Under the MSMED Act: A Guide for Startups](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/msme-delayed-payment-recovery-msmed-act/): How micro and small enterprises recover delayed payments under the MSMED Act: the 45-day rule, interest at three times the RBI bank rate, MSE Facilitation Council and the 75% deposit rule.
- [How to Reply to a Legal Notice: A Guide for Businesses in Gurugram](https://www.millenniumchambers.in/reply-to-legal-notice-gurugram/): How businesses in Gurugram (Gurgaon) should handle a legal notice: when a notice is mandatory, Section 138 and Section 12A timelines, what a reply contains and the admission risk under the Limitation Act.
